item.title: アメックス、26年利益見通し上方修正 世界で5％人員削減へ
item.description:
Manya Saini Arasu Kannagi Basil
[２３日 ロイター] - 米クレジットカード大手アメリ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アメックス、26年利益見通し上方修正　世界で5％人員削減へ 0:36 配信

2026年7月17日に撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo/File Photo

Manya Saini　Arasu Kannagi Basil

[２３日 ロイター] - 米クレジットカード大手アメリカン・エキスプレス（アメックス）は２３日、２０２６年通期の利益予想を市場予想を上回る水準に引き上げた。また、事業再編の一環として世界の従業員の５％に当たる約３５００人を削減する計画を発表した。

スティーブン・スクエリ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はアナリストに対し、業績は好調に推移しているものの、より「機動的で効率的な」組織になる必要があると説明した。

通期の調整後１株利益予想は１７．６０─１７．９０ドル。レンジの中央値は、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想の１７．６３ドルを上回る。

アメックスは、信用スコアが高く可処分所得の多い富裕層を顧客として取り込むことで、経済全体の減速や不確実性の影響を受けにくい事業基盤を築いてきた。２６年の業績は好調に推移している。

ただ、マーケティング支出を増やし、新たな特典を付けてカードを刷新したことから、投資家は経費の増加を注視している。

第３・四半期（９月３０日まで）の連結経費は前年同期比９％増の１４５億ドルだった。

第３・四半期の調整後１株利益は４．６８ドルと、市場予想の約４．４８ドルを大幅に上回った。

第３・四半期の旅行・娯楽関連のカード利用額は前年同期比１０％増加した。航空分野が１３％増、飲食店分野が９％増となり、全体をけん引した。

アメックスが発行する全カードの利用総額を示す「ビルド・ビジネス」は、第３・四半期に８％増の４５４０億ドルとなった。売上高は９％増の２０１億ドルだった。

アプタス・キャピタル・アドバイザーズの株式部門責任者兼ポートフォリオマネジャー、デービッド・ワグナー氏は「富裕層の支出は底堅く、この顧客層に経済的な負担が増している兆候はない。低所得層の消費者とは対照的だ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米20年国債は廃止されるのか　利払い費増大で議論高まる アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 10/24(土) 0:36 ロイター

item.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) questionable for Sunday
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas with a calf injury, head coach Sean McVay said Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas with a calf injury, head coach Sean McVay said Friday. Nacua sustained the injury during Thursday's practice and did not participate in Friday's session as the Rams (2-4) prepared to face the Raiders (3-3). The Rams already are without fellow wideout Davante Adams, who was placed on injured reserve earlier in the week with a ruptured hamstring. Remaining Los Angeles wide receivers include Konata Mumpfield, Jordan Whittington, Tutu Atwell, CJ Daniels and Alex Bachman. Nacua, 25, has 37 catches for 417 yards and one touchdown to go with one rushing score in four games this season. He missed two games with a hip/groin injury. A two-time Pro Bowl selection, Nacua led the NFL with 129 receptions last season and racked up 1,715 receiving yards with 10 touchdowns in 16 games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump says he will fix any Starlink access problem in Ukraine
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that if there was still a problem with access to Starlink communication systems in Ukraine, he would get it straightened out.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that if there was still a problem with access to Starlink communication systems in Ukraine, he would get it straightened out. Trump told reporters at the White House that he had not spoken to SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk about the matter but, if access was not fixed, he would speak to him. "If there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out," Trump said. The caps have been in place since October 13 as relations between Kyiv and Washington deteriorated Ukrainian officials said on Friday that speed [USN:L8N4691E6 TEXT:"restrictions"] on Starlink communication systems in Ukraine remained in place, contradicting Trump's previous statement that the services had been fully restored. "Elon will never do anything wrong. I know him very well. He's a fair person, and you know it's an unusual situation where they're talking to a private company. But he's not going to do anything that's wrong," Trump said.

item.title: トランプ氏、イラン戦争「速やかに終結可能」 自然に収束か見極めも
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、米国はイランとの戦争を速やかに終結させることができるとの見方を示した。一方で、米政府が早期の決着を目指すべきか、紛争が徐々に収束するのを待つべきかについては疑問を呈した。

トランプ氏は「われわれは非常に迅速に終わらせることができる」と述べた上で、「終わらせたいのか、それとも自然に収束するのを待つべきか、それが問題だ」と語った。

また、米国はイランの石油を全て奪取することができるとも主張した。

item.title: Poulter confirms LIV Golf exit to focus on senior golf and family
item.description: England's Ian Poulter is the latest player to leave LIV Golf, saying he will not be part of the proposed 2.0 relaunch as he looks to focus on senior golf and spend more time with family.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England's Ian Poulter is the latest player to leave LIV Golf, saying he will not be part of the proposed 2.0 relaunch as he looks to focus on senior golf and spend more time with family. Poulter's announcement comes days after former British Open champion [USN:L4N4670A3 TEXT:"Louis Oosthuizen"] said he was moving on from the breakaway circuit, whose future remains uncertain. Former world number one Jon Rahm is also among those quitting LIV, which is fighting to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund said in April it was cutting funding. LIV has secured investment from [USN:L4N45R1JI TEXT:"BC Partners Credit"] and is set to make a decision this month on whether it winds down or moves forward with a 2.0 model. "I have decided to not move forward with being part of LIV 2.0," Poulter said in a lengthy post on X. "Needless to say, it was a tough decision and one I thought about and discussed at length with my family and team." The 50-year-old, a five-times Ryder Cup winner, did not win an individual or team title during his time with LIV but boasts 17 professional victories, including three on the PGA Tour. "Ultimately, the opportunity to spend more time at home with my family, reduce international travel, focus on senior golf and have the opportunity to pursue other interests was something that I felt was right for me at this stage of my life and career," Poulter said. He was part of LIV's inaugural event in June 2022 and later became one of the leaders of Majesticks GC alongside Lee Westwood and Henrik Stenson. Poulter was among a group of established stars who accepted lucrative contracts to join the breakaway circuit from the traditional tours and was a vocal defender of the move. “Change is never easy and it's fair to say professional golf has experienced plenty of it over the last few years," Poulter said. "But I've always believed that change can create opportunity and ultimately lead to positive outcomes." England's Tyrrell Hatton also confirmed on Friday that he would not be part of LIV 2.0, expressing gratitude to the tournament's organisers on Instagram. The 35-year-old, an eight-time DP World Tour winner, said he was excited for the next chapter of his career.

item.title: ロ中銀、政策金利14％に据え置き インフレ見通し引き上げ
item.description:
Elena Fabrichnaya Gleb Bryanski
[モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elena Fabrichnaya　Gleb Bryanski

[モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] - ロシア中央銀行は２３日、主要政策金利を１４％に据え置くことを決定した。物価上昇圧力とインフレ期待が高止まりしており、９月会合に続いて金利を維持した。２０２６年のインフレ率見通しについては７．１─７．６％と、従来の６．０─７．０％から引き上げた。

今回の据え置き決定は、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト２０人の予想と一致した。中銀は２７年の平均政策金利の見通しを１２．５─１３．５％と、従来の１０．５─１２．５％から引き上げた。

ロシアでは、今年に入ってウクライナによるドローン攻撃で多くの製油所が操業停止し、ガソリンやディーゼル燃料（軽油）の価格が上昇。公共料金の値上げもあり、インフレ率が高止まりしている。中銀は、２７年に目標とする４％に落ち着くと見込んでいる。

中銀は「特定の分野での一時的な生産能力の低下の影響があり、基礎的な物価上昇率は鈍化していない」との見方を示した。燃料価格が物価動向全般に影響を与える一方、「特定分野の生産能力の長期的な縮小」がインフレリスクにつながると言及した。

ロシアの財政赤字は２６年に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３．２％に悪化する見通し。軍事費がかさみ歳出は１３％増える見込み。２６年の経済成長率見通しは０．６％で、高金利環境で経済成長が抑制され、政府の債務返済に影響が出る可能性がある。

item.title: Plazas en Brasil ajustan posiciones antes de balotaje; inversores ya miran a la Fed
item.description: Los mercados financieros de Brasil avanzaron el viernes, mientras los inversores ajustaban posiciones previo a lo que se espera sea un reñido balotaje presidencial, con las monedas de la región cotizando mixtas con la mira ya puesta también en la próxima reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Los mercados financieros de Brasil avanzaron el viernes, mientras los inversores ajustaban posiciones previo a lo que se espera sea un reñido balotaje presidencial, con las monedas de la región cotizando mixtas con la mira ya puesta también en la próxima reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal. * El real brasileño ganó un 0,97% a 4,9896 por dólar, para marcar un avance del 1,64% en la semana; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) sumó preliminarmete un 0,76% a 205.679 puntos. * Los inversores ajustaron posiciones de cara a la segunda vuelta presidencial del domingo en la mayor economía de América Latina, con la expectativa de que el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro supere al presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Bolsonaro lidera los sondeos de opinión, aunque la ventaja se fue estrechando en los últimos días. * Una encuesta de Datafolha divulgada la noche del jueves mostró que ambos se encontraban igualados con 50% de los votos válidamente emitidos. La semana pasada el candidato opositor contaba con un 51% y el actual mandatario con 49% con la muestra de votos válidos, que no considera los blancos, los nulos ni los indecisos. * El senador ganó la primera vuelta, aunque la mayoría de las encuestas mostraba una ventaja de Lula. * Los otros mercados también reaccionaban más tranquilos luego de que en la víspera fueran golpeados por una búsqueda de seguridad por parte de los inversores. * Los precios del crudo volvieron a subir con fuerza en la sesión, con el contrato referencial Brent superando los 116 dólares por barril, alimentando los temores sobre una inflación relacionada con la energía que al parecer ya se traspasa a la economía en general. * La Fed culmina el miércoles su reunión de dos días y aunque los mercados descuentan que mantendrá sin cambios las tasas de interés, buscarán pistas en el comunicado y en la posterior conferencia de prensa del jefe del organismo, Kevin Warsh, sobre futuras decisiones. Los operadores esperan un alza de 25 puntos básicos en diciembre. * El peso mexicano subía por la tarde un 0,24%, a 18,6547 unidades por dólar, tras un descenso en las primeras operaciones, aunque anotó su séptima semana consecutiva de descenso, golpeado por un desmantelamiento de operaciones de carry trade ante expectativas de una disminución del diferencial de tasas entre Estados Unidos y México. * Mientras, el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, cotizó prácticamente estable a 69.879,62 puntos. De todas formas terminó la semana con una leve alza. * A nivel local, la [USN:AQN2MPJKQ TEXT:"actividad económica"] moderó su ritmo de crecimiento en agosto, aunque menos de lo previsto. El dato antecede a la divulgación, la próxima semana, de las cifras oportunas del PIB del tercer trimestre. * "Estos resultados, en conjunto con la información disponible de julio y los datos conocidos de septiembre, llevan a prever que la actividad económica crecerá un 1,0% trimestral en el tercer trimestre de 2026, equivalente a un avance del 3,4% interanual. Considerando esto, revisamos al alza nuestro pronóstico para el PIB de todo el 2026 a 1,9%, desde 1,4%", dijo Banorte. * El peso colombiano se apreció un 0,91% a 3.145 unidades por dólar, en su segunda sesión de alzas; al tiempo que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el COLCAP (.COLCAP) , repuntó un 0,46% a 2.540,1 puntos. * "La ganancia local estuvo asociada al aumento de los precios del petróleo, principal producto de exportación del país, y a la expectativa de flujos de dólares provenientes del endeudamiento externo esperado del Gobierno en las próximas semanas", explicó el Banco de Bogotá en una nota. * El peso chileno , cerró las operaciones con una caída del 0,73%, en 993,50/993,80 unidades por dólar y acumuló un retroceso del 0,97% durante la semana. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , moderó sus descensos previos y cayó un 0,31%, a 10.746,36 puntos. * El peso mayorista argentino bajó un leve 0,1% a 1.529,5 por dólar, con la intervención diaria del banco central (BCRA) que acumuló compras por 270 millones de dólares en el transcurso de la semana, contabilizados los 42 millones adquiridos este viernes. Las reservas de la autoridad monetaria suman 50.203 millones de dólares en base al último dato oficial provisorio. * El índice líder MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, saltó un 4,29% al cierre en línea a los 'ADRs' de Nueva York. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,12% a 3,4470/3,4490 unidades por dólar y cayó un 0,29% en la semana. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) cayó un 0,22% 1.513,47 puntos.

item.title: Wall Street cierra en baja para terminar complicada semana
item.description: El Dow Jones y el S&P 500 cerraron a la baja el viernes, mientras que las acciones tecnológicas se estabilizaron tras una semana turbulenta para el sector de la inteligencia artificial, que ha sido el principal motor del mercado, con los inversores atentos a una intensa agenda de resultados corporativos y a la próxima reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
item.content:encoded: El Dow Jones y el S&P 500 cerraron a la baja el viernes, mientras que las acciones tecnológicas se estabilizaron tras una semana turbulenta para el sector de la inteligencia artificial, que ha sido el principal motor del mercado, con los inversores atentos a una intensa agenda de resultados corporativos y a la próxima reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal. * La mayoría de los sectores del S&P 500 registraron descensos el viernes, destacando las caídas en los grupos de consumo básico y financiero. * La próxima semana, cerca de un tercio de las firmas que componen el S&P 500 presentarán sus resultados trimestrales, entre ellas Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Amazon (AMZN.O) . Estas tres grandes compañías, clave en el desarrollo de la IA, verán cómo sus previsiones de gasto de capital son seguidas de cerca por Wall Street. * Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 39,57 puntos, o un 0,52%, a 7.623,86 puntos; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cedió 55,17 puntos, o un 0,21%, a 25.955,34 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 658,82 puntos, o un 1,25%, a 52.209,16 unidades. * Las acciones del sector de telecomunicaciones registraron caídas, lastrando al de servicios de comunicación, tras conocerse un informe que indicó que SpaceX (SPCX.O) estaba buscando miles de emplazamientos para antenas de telefonía móvil, con el fin de establecer un cuarto operador de telecomunicaciones inalámbricas. * El sector energético (.SPNY) subió, alcanzando un máximo histórico. El precio del crudo Brent tocó su nivel más alto desde finales de abril, después de que los ataques de los hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaran la preocupación por posibles interrupciones en el suministro energético proveniente de Oriente Medio. * Se espera que la Reserva Federal mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios cuando publique su comunicado de política monetaria el próximo miércoles. Sin embargo, los inversores buscarán con interés cualquier indicio sobre si el banco central estadounidense subirá los tipos en su reunión de diciembre. * Asimismo, Wall Street presta cada vez más atención a las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre, que determinarán el control del Congreso de los Estados Unidos.

item.title: France Veillée d'armes avant une nouvelle journée de manifestations, le dispositif sécuritaire renforcé
item.description: La France se préparait vendredi à une nouvelle journée de manifestations à hauts risques samedi, une semaine après les violences et les pillages survenus en marge de défilés pour les conditions d'enseignement détériorées et contre la vie chère, obligeant l'exécutif à un sursaut.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La France se préparait vendredi à une nouvelle journée de manifestations à hauts risques samedi, une semaine après les violences et les pillages survenus en marge de défilés pour les conditions d'enseignement détériorées et contre la vie chère, obligeant l'exécutif à un sursaut. Comme le 17 octobre, plusieurs centaines de milliers de personnes pourraient défiler samedi dans tout le pays, selon des prévisions non confirmées par les autorités. Le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, a annoncé la mobilisation de 70.000 membres des forces de sécurité intérieure - soit environ 10.000 de plus que la semaine dernière - dont des unités spécialisées comme le GIGN, la BRI et le RAID, en plus de la présence dans les gares et les aéroports de militaires du dispositif Sentinelle. "Nous serons intraitables", a-t-il dit lors d'un point de presse à son ministère. "On ne laissera rien passer." Outre les quelque 2.400 individus interpellés le 17 octobre, "près de 500 personnes" ont été arrêtées après investigations, a-t-il précisé. Après un conseil de défense et de sécurité dans la matinée, le président Emmanuel Macron a reçu dans l'après-midi des représentants des lycéens, mobilisés depuis plus d'un mois pour obtenir de meilleures conditions d'études et désormais rejoints par d'autres Français réclamant du pouvoir d'achat. "Ce dialogue qui a lieu alors que se clôt la phase de consultation des lycéens ouvre la voie aux annonces qui seront faites par le Premier ministre lundi prochain. Des décisions concrètes seront prises, pour le court comme le moyen terme", a déclaré l'entourage du chef de l'Etat. "Il a été question des conditions d’étude et de la nécessité de rénover le bâti scolaire, des rythmes scolaires et des emplois du temps qui requièrent des simplifications, de la meilleure prise en charge de la santé des jeunes, et des difficultés liées à l’orientation en fin de lycée", poursuit cette source, soulignant qu'Emmanuel Macron a exprimé le besoin d'une refonte en profondeur de Parcoursup, plateforme d'accès à l'enseignement supérieur. Le chef de l'Etat devait visiter en fin de journée une caserne de police dans le XIXe arrondissement de Paris pour témoigner "sa reconnaissance aux forces de sécurité intérieure mobilisées depuis le week-end dernier" et dire "sa confiance à l'ensemble des effectifs appelé à intervenir dans les prochains jours", a fait savoir l'Elysée. Le Premier ministre, Sébastien Lecornu, a confirmé dans la soirée que le gouvernement allait "bouger" sur Parcoursup, sans plus de précisions. JOURNÉE DE GRÈVE ET DE MANIFESTATIONS LE 5 NOVEMBRE Après les violences et le pillage de quelque 3.000 boutiques et magasins le 17 octobre, le chef de l'Etat a annoncé jeudi [USN:S8N3QT0LD TEXT:"l'interdiction"] des manifestations et regroupements sans "légitimité" et des "tracés alternatifs" pour protéger les centre-villes. A Paris, la préfecture de police a finalement interdit le parcours proposé pour le samedi par la CGT entre Bastille et Nation après l'avoir accepté dans un premier temps. Elle propose à la place "un tracé de porte d'Italie à porte de Vincennes via le boulevard des Maréchaux, pour une manifestation de 13 heures à 19 heures". Le défilé proposé par les "Gilets jaunes" entre Opéra et Bastille avait été interdit d'emblée. Les musées d'Orsay, de l'Orangerie, du Louvre, le musée Picasso seront fermés, ainsi que le Grand Palais où se devait se poursuivre ce week-end la foire annuelle d'art contemporain Art Basel Paris. A Limoges (Haute-Vienne), Sébastien Lecornu a appelé à la transparence sur ce qui s'est passé dans l'incendie criminel de la mairie samedi dernier, notant que "les faits sont particulièrement graves, plus graves que ce que l'on pensait". Aux côtés du maire de la ville, Guillaume Guérin, le chef du gouvernement a souligné que "ceux qui mis le feu sont responsables". "Ce sont des actes délibérés, planifiés", a-t-il dit, assurant que l'Etat allait reconstruire la mairie à l'identique et que le contribuable local ne payerait pas. S'agissant des manifestations de samedi, Sébastien Lecornu a déclaré que le "retour d'expérience avait été fait" après les violences qui ont émaillé la mobilisation du 17 octobre et que le dispositif prévu se serait pas le même que celui de la semaine passée. Il a ajouté que le niveau de menace restait élevé pour samedi avec notamment l'ultra gauche. Des préfectures ont interdit la tenue de manifestations à Lyon, Rouen, Le Havre, Nice, Chambéry, Le Mans ou encore Grenoble mais les choses pourraient encore évoluer en fonction des situations locales. Le préfet des Bouches-du-Rhône a ainsi annoncé dans l'après-midi qu'il autorisait la tenue, à Marseille, d'une manifestation à l'appel de la CGT. "Chaque préfet examine de très près les manifestations déclarées ou pas", a dit Laurent Nuñez, qui a évoqué de possibles défilés "en périphérie des centres-villes". Après une visite à [USN:L8N4690V5 TEXT:"Trappes"] dans les Yvelines, où une fusillade a fait un mort et quatre blessés, le ministre de l'Intérieur était attendu à Orléans pour y superviser les préparatifs de la manifestation de samedi. Entre 20.000 et 30.000 opposants venus de "toute la France", selon une prévision de la préfecture du Loiret, sont attendus à Orléans, ville de Jeanne d'Arc, pour un défilé hostile au Rassemblement national, qui y tient son congrès tout le week-end. La secrétaire générale de la CGT, Sophie Binet, le Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste, Olivier Faure, et le maire La France insoumise de Saint-Denis (Seine-Saint-Denis), Bally Bagayoko, participeront à ce rassemblement sous haute protection policière qui partira à 10h30 de la cathédrale d'Orléans. Une journée nationale de grève et de manifestations, à l'appel de l'ensemble des organisations syndicales, est prévue le 5 novembre. C'est dans ce contexte tendu que le Rassemblement national, favori de l'élection présidentielle du printemps 2027, tient son congrès annuel à Orléans. Seul candidat à sa réélection, le président du parti Jordan Bardella sera reconduit samedi, et la candidate Marine Le Pen prononcera le lendemain un discours de lancement de sa campagne. Selon plusieurs sondages réalisés depuis le 17 octobre, la quadruple candidate à l'Elysée reste largement en tête des intentions de vote au premier tour, autour de 35%, loin devant le candidat de la France insoumise Jean-Luc Mélenchon, en position de se qualifier pour le second tour à environ 18%. Le leader insoumis a une courte avance sur d'autres candidats comme l'ancien Premier ministre Edouard Philippe et le gagnant de la primaire sociale-démocrate Raphaël Glucksmann.

item.title: 米ミシガン大消費者信頼感10月確報は48.0、中間選挙控え過去最低に迫る
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２３日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．０と、９月の４８．１から...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感10月確報は48.0、中間選挙控え過去最低に迫る 0:06 配信

米ニューヨーク市で食料品の買い物をしている人々。８月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[２３日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２３日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．０と、９月の４８．１から小幅低下し、過去最低に迫る水準となった。生活費を主な争点とする米中間選挙を目前に控え、中東紛争に伴う物価上昇が家計の景況感を悪化させていることを示した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４６．３。１０月の速報値も４６．３だった。

１０月は、イラン戦争開始から間もない５月に記録した過去最低の４４．８に次ぐ、調査開始以来２番目に低い水準となった。消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「購買力が依然として、消費者の景況感を左右する主な要因となっている」と指摘。「信頼感は現在、１年前より１０％低く、イラン紛争直前の２月よりも１５％低い」と述べた。

支持政党別では、重要な浮動票層を構成する「無党派」と自認する回答者が景況感の悪化を主導した。無党派層では信頼感指数は４２．４と、９月の４７．７から低下し、過去最低を記録した５月の４０．６をわずかに上回る水準にとどまった。一方、民主党支持者と共和党支持者では信頼感指数は改善した。

１年後のインフレ期待は４．７％と、９月の４．６％から小幅上昇した。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争開始前の２月時点では３．４％だった。

５年後のインフレ期待は３．５％。９月は３．４％だった。

調査によると、今年は無党派層および共和党支持者の間で、物価高が個人の家計を圧迫していると指摘する回答が著しく増えた。１月以降、インフレ圧力が家計状況を悪化させていると指摘する無党派層の数は２７％増加、共和党支持者では５２％も急増した。一方、民主党支持者では１５％増にとどまった。

株式市場へのエクスポージャーがない、または限定的な世帯も、年初に比べて物価高が家計の重しになっていると指摘する頻度が高まっている。これらの世帯は、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームへの期待を受けここ最近まで急上昇していた株式市場の恩恵を十分に受けていない。

前出のスー氏は「消費者は概してインフレの加速を予想しており、今年のインフレ期待の上昇は、特定の政治的立場に限られたものではない」と指摘。「経済に対する悲観的な見方にもかかわらず、消費者支出全体が比較的底堅く推移しているという事実は、警戒すべきもう一つの理由となる。消費の一部が現在、将来の物価上昇を回避するための予防的な支出を反映しているのであれば、ディスインフレ（インフレ鈍化）の達成は一段と困難になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ムスリム候補者をやり玉に、米中間選挙でイスラム教を争点化する共和党 アングル：米中間選挙が事実上の最終盤入り、トランプ氏の共和党に暗雲 焦点：共和党、初の中間選挙全国大会を来月開催　トランプ支持再燃狙う アングル：米中間選挙の「キングメーカー」様変わり　ＡＩやオンライン賭博が資金拠出の主役 焦点：米中間選挙巡る賭け急増、予測市場のインサイダー対策は苦戦か 最終更新: 10/24(土) 0:54 ロイター

JOHANNESBURG, Oct 23 : South Africa's presidency temporarily took its website offline following a PHP warning, presidential spokesperson Vincent Magwenya told Reuters on Friday, adding there was no indication of a security breach. "While such warnings do not indicate a security breach, they can affect the normal operation of a website," Magwenya said. He added that the website was taken down as a precaution. Governments and businesses worldwide have rushed to secure systems running the PHP programming language after flaws were disclosed, forcing some services offline and triggering millions of hacking attempts in one of the most significant cybersecurity incidents in recent years. PHP underpins a large share of the public web and is widely used by content management systems including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla, giving any critical vulnerability potentially widespread consequences. PHP developers on Wednesday released fixes for the flaws and urged users to update affected systems immediately.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Ex-FBI officials charged with lying to Congress about Hunter Biden probes
item.description: The US Justice Department has charged two former senior FBI officials with lying to Congress about their knowledge of investigations into former President Joe Biden's son, Hunter, according to court documents made public on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department has charged two former senior FBI officials with lying to Congress about their knowledge of investigations into former President Joe Biden's son, Hunter, according to court documents made public on Friday. Nikki Floris, 46, and Bradley Benavides, 56, who each held senior counterintelligence roles at the FBI, were charged in federal court in Washington. They allegedly misled a House of Representatives panel about the role of an FBI foreign influence task force in investigations into Hunter Biden, according to a criminal complaint. The case marks the [USN:L6N3YE1CB TEXT:"latest attempt"] by the Justice Department to investigate and prosecute US officials over incidents that angered President Donald Trump and his allies. Floris and Benavides served in leading roles on the FBI foreign influence task force, a group aimed at combating attempts to influence US elections that was disbanded during the second Trump administration after facing criticism from Republicans. The officials briefed two Republican senators in 2020, warning them of US intelligence concerns that some allegations against Hunter Biden were part of a Russian influence operation, according to prior media reports. Lawyers for Floris condemned the case on Friday as the latest in a string of politically motivated prosecutions by the DOJ under the Trump administration. "The government’s reasons for charging Nikki are as transparent as they are unjust: to push a false narrative for a shot at political points," Floris' lawyers said in a statement. A lawyer for Benavides called the charges a "disgrace" and said Benavides is a "true patriot who devoted his career to protecting this country and its people." "Lying to Congress by anyone strikes at the heart of our democratic system, but when senior FBI agents lie to Congress believing they are above the law, it’s time to bring the hammer of justice down on them," US Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro wrote in a social media post. Floris and Benavides made an initial court appearance on Friday. A federal grand jury in Washington will have to approve an indictment for the case to move forward. A TRUMP GRIEVANCE The case centers on an issue that has long been a focus of Trump and his allies: the FBI's handling of a laptop purportedly belonging to Hunter Biden that surfaced in the weeks leading up to the 2020 election, which Trump lost to Joe Biden. The criminal complaint alleges that Floris and Benavides lied to the House Judiciary Committee in 2023 testimony where they each claimed little knowledge of the Hunter Biden investigation and the laptop episode. It alleges that Floris and Benavides were in contact with members of the Hunter Biden investigative team in 2020 and took part in the FBI's response to public reporting on the laptop. Benavides told the House panel that he learned about the Hunter Biden probes through searching on Wikipedia, according to the complaint. Hunter Biden was later charged with federal [USN:L1N38C1OP TEXT:"gun and tax-related crimes"] during his father's administration. Joe Biden [USN:S0N3HW02C TEXT:"pardoned his son"] shortly before leaving office. Trump and his allies have [USN:L1N34O1PW TEXT:"long claimed"] that the FBI, during Trump's first term, and social media companies, suppressed the laptop story to protect Joe Biden's campaign. The case against Floris and Benavides does not make that allegation. The DOJ under Trump has also investigated the [USN:L1N41O0U1 TEXT:"US intelligence community's finding"] that Russia sought to aid Trump's 2016 campaign and the FBI raid of Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort for classified documents in 2022. That probe has been [USN:L6N4521BD TEXT:"mired in staff turmoil"]. The DOJ has also brought charges against former FBI Director James Comey for allegedly lying to Congress about media leaks, a case that was later dismissed, and for allegedly threatening Trump in a social media post that featured seashells arranged to form the numbers "86 47."

item.title: Altibajos en plaza financiera de Argentina, ojos puestos en elección de Brasil
item.description: Los negocios financieros de Argentina mostraban un sesgo selectivo el viernes con las miradas enfocadas básicamente en temas de la política internacional, previo a elecciones presidenciales clave en el vecino Brasil y un nuevo incremento en el precio del petróleo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los negocios financieros de Argentina mostraban un sesgo selectivo el viernes con las miradas enfocadas básicamente en temas de la política internacional, previo a elecciones presidenciales clave en el vecino Brasil y un nuevo incremento en el precio del petróleo. Las acciones bursátiles fueron las estrellas de la ronda con una fuerte recuperación. Brasil, el principal socio comercial de Argentina, elige el domingo en [USN:L6N4670YH TEXT:"balotaje"] a su presidente, entre la reelección del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y el referente liberal Flávio Bolsonaro, este último afín al mandatario nacional Javier Milei. Los últimos sondeos arrojan un reñido final. "En base a lo que pasó en la primera ronda, todo indicaría que Bolsonaro logre un ajustado triunfo y parte de los activos ya lo descuentan en precios, lo que consolidaría a la derecha en toda Sudamérica y le generaría un gran respaldo a Milei por su alineamiento con (el presidente estadounidense, Donald) Trump", dijo un agente corporativo de Bull Market Brokers. Acotó que "el enfrentamiento político de Milei con Lula es manifiesto y si la centroizquierda sigue gobernando en Brasil, podría ser un mal augurio de cara a necesarias nuevas alianzas económicas y financieras en la región, más cuando en 2027 hay elecciones presidenciales acá (en Argentina)". El flamante índice líder MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa porteña saltó un 4,29% al cierre en línea a los 'ADRs' de Nueva York y los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaron un negativo del 0,2%, luego de perder el 1,31% y un 0,9% respectivamente el jueves cuando el riesgo país volvió a superar la línea de los 700 puntos básicos. Este referencial del banco JP.Morgan oscilaba ahora en las 710 unidades (1425 GMT), zona como máximo guarismo en un año. "Aunque las encuestas han mostrado un estrechamiento en la diferencia, Flávio Bolsonaro llega a la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales en Brasil este domingo como favorito, y su victoria parece estar, en gran medida, ya descontada por los mercados", reportó Capital Economics. Las presiones geopolíticas por el cruce bélico en Oriente Medio impulsa el alza general de precios, lo que aviva la posibilidad de un nuevo incremento en la tasa de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal a corto plazo. "La caída de las acciones tecnológicas pierde fuerza, aunque una nueva suba del petróleo limita el alivio en los mercados. El Brent toca su nivel más alto desde comienzos de mayo (unos 116 dólares) y puede agregar presiones inflacionarias", comentó Quantum Finanzas. El peso mayorista bajó un leve 0,1% a 1.529,5 por dólar , con la intervención diaria del banco central (BCRA) que acumuló compras por 270 millones de dólares en el transcurso de la semana, contabilizados los 42 millones adquiridos este viernes. Las reservas de la autoridad monetaria suman 50.203 millones de dólares en base al último dato oficial provisorio.

item.title: Bristol Myers discloses patient death in early-stage cell therapy study
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb on Friday disclosed a patient death in an early-stage trial studying its experimental CAR-T cell therapy in patients with relapsing or progressive forms of multiple sclerosis.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy
item.content:encoded: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) on Friday disclosed a patient death in an early-stage trial studying its experimental CAR-T cell therapy in patients with relapsing or progressive forms of multiple sclerosis. The death, which the company said occurred after the study was paused, was disclosed as part of a readout at a conference. The patient, who was participating in the trial of the company's experimental cell therapy zolacabtagene autoleucel, or zola-cel, died of septic pneumonia a day after receiving high-dose chemotherapy, and 44 days after the CAR-T infusion. The company said the patient with highly active relapsing MS had developed delayed motor symptoms that did not respond to treatment. "The patient had a late onset side effect, a series of other complications and was heavily pretreated prior to CAR T, confounding our ability to determine the root cause of the issue," a company spokesperson said. The death was unrelated to a recent voluntary pause on other studies on zola-cel, the spokesperson said. In September, Bristol said it implemented a [USN:L6N44T08D TEXT:"voluntary pause"] on studies for zola-cel to review safety data, after Novartis (NOVN.S) halted eight clinical trials of its experimental cell therapy. Bristol is working with the FDA to restart all studies and aims to resume enrollment in early 2027, the spokesperson said. Shares of the drugmaker were trading more than 2% lower on Friday. Zola-cel targets CD19, a protein found on certain cells that are believed to play a role in autoimmune diseases. The early-stage trial enrolled 66 patients with relapsing or progressive forms of MS. The company said the majority of the side effects were brief and reversible, generally consistent with the previously reported zola-cel data, and that the findings support the therapy's potential to reset the immune system in people with autoimmune diseases. "We remain confident in the safety and efficacy profile we have observed in Phase 1, which has demonstrated preliminary transformational treatment-free responses across multiple autoimmune settings and manageable safety," the spokesperson said. No additional severe side effects have been reported across all zola-cel programs in autoimmune diseases, which include 190 patients treated in early studies, the company said.

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Six more companies, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit, will not allow their shares to be tokenized on a joint trading platform backed by crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange, according to a regulatory document seen by Reuters.  The new objections, which have not been previously reported, underscore the growing challenges for tokenization, the creation of digital tokens that represent a stock and can be traded on a blockchain similar to cryptocurrencies, despite the US securities regulator recently approving the novel products.  In total, 22 companies have objected, according to the document, which outlines the rules of the OKXICE venture and which companies have objected. It does not say why the companies objected. Sixteen of the companies, including Microsoft and Alphabet, are listed on Nasdaq. The others are listed on the New York Stock Exchange, which ICE owns. Nasdaq has teamed up with Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, to launch its own tokenized stock platform next year.

A spokesperson for Arm did not immediately provide comment. Spokespeople for Wells Fargo and Intuit declined to comment.  TOKENIZATION ADVOCATES TOUT 24/7 TRADING The cryptocurrency industry has said stock tokenization could revolutionize markets by allowing shares to be traded 24/7 and settled instantly. OKX and ICE had planned to tokenize 63 stocks through their joint venture, but have encountered objections from issuers. OKX and ICE filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this month to launch tokenized stocks under the agency's new innovation exemption. The exemption allows platforms that facilitate trading of tokenized stocks to operate without complying with many requirements that apply to traditional stock exchanges.  Under the exemption, platforms must notify companies before listing tokenized versions of their stocks, and cannot proceed if the issuer objects.   Speaking to reporters this week, Andrew Cuomo, co-chairman of the OKXICE joint venture, said given how revolutionary tokenization could be, it was natural for companies to take a "wait and see" approach, CoinDesk reported. While Nasdaq says it welcomes tokenization in principle, it has said such products should be subject to the existing set of rules and investor protections. It has warned that if improperly regulated, tokenization could fragment liquidity and undermine price discovery, among other issues.  "Given the risks we believe issuers must be cautious about their participation," the company warned in a September FAQ.  A Nasdaq spokesperson pointed Reuters to its FAQ. Although many overseas tokenized stocks are marketed like stocks, they rarely offer the same rights, disclosures and protections as traditional equities.  Under the SEC's exemption, tokenized stocks must confer the same rights and privileges as traditional securities, including the ability to receive dividends and exercise voting rights.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米総合ＰＭＩ、10月は57.6に小幅低下 販売価格4年超ぶり高水準
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した１０月の米総合購買...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米総合ＰＭＩ、10月は57.6に小幅低下　販売価格4年超ぶり高水準 10/23 23:41 配信

米ペンシルベニア州キャンプヒルにあるＡＭＥＳのシャベル製造工場。2017年6月撮影。REUTERS/Tim Aeppel

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２３日発表した１０月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５７．６と、５年ぶり高水準を付けた９月の５８．４から小幅低下した。それでも、堅調な需要を背景に、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの価格を引き上げており、今後数カ月でインフレが一段と加速し、高止まりする可能性があることを示した。

１０月は製造業が底堅く推移したものの、広範なサービス業の小幅な後退によって相殺された。 新規受注指数は５８．２と、前月の５８．１から小幅上昇し、２０２２年３月以来の高水準となった。上昇は主にサービス業によるもので、Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは「予防的な在庫積み増しに一部押し上げられた国内需要の高まり」と輸出の伸びを指摘した。

販売価格指数は５９．８と、９月の５８．４から上昇し、２２年８月以来の高水準となった。製造業・サービス業の双方で企業が価格を引き上げた。

投入価格指数は６４．９と、９月の６５．９から低下したものの、依然として高水準にある。ただ、製造業は今月も価格上昇に直面しており、同指数はなお４年ぶり高水準付近で推移した。

サプライヤー納入指数は３８．１と、９月の４０．９から低下し、４年超ぶりの低水準となった。

９月に急増していた全体の雇用は１０月に低下したものの、製造業では雇用が伸び、製造業の雇用指数は１２年３月以来の高水準となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフビジネスエコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は「コスト圧力は引き続き重大な懸念だ」と指摘。「一方で、サプライチェーン（供給網）のボトルネックの問題が深刻化し、受注残が積み上がっている。このため企業はコスト上昇分を顧客に転嫁しやすくなっている」と述べた。

item.title: Explainer-Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand
item.description: Oct 23 : Fuel cells are gaining traction among US hyperscalers racing to build data centers for the AI boom but struggling with grid constraints to secure quick and reliable power. Energy research firm Rystad Energy projects investments in fuel cells for data centers to rise to about $30 billion by 2030 from
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Business

Explainer-Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand

FILE PHOTO: A technician works at an Amazon Web Services AI data center in New Carlisle, Indiana, U.S., October 2, 2025. REUTERS/Noah Berger for AWS/File Photo

23 Oct 2026 10:26PM

FAST

Oct 23 : Fuel cells are gaining traction among US hyperscalers racing to build data centers for the AI boom but struggling with grid constraints to secure quick and reliable power. Energy research firm Rystad Energy projects investments in fuel cells for data centers to rise to about $30 billion by 2030 from $2.8 billion in 2025. WHAT ARE FUEL CELLS? A fuel cell generates electricity through a chemical reaction between a fuel, such as natural gas or hydrogen, and oxygen, converting the fuel's energy directly into electricity rather than burning it.

Show Less

Bloom Energy operates solid-oxide technology ready for 100 per cent pure hydrogen, while FuelCell Energy uses molten carbonate technology capped at 40 per cent hydrogen blends, even as both systems are fuel-flexible. WHY IS DEMAND GROWING? Data centers require massive amounts of reliable electricity to run computing equipment and cooling systems around the clock. Linking large electricity loads to the US grid can take three to six years, according to Rystad estimates, prodding developers to explore on-site power sources. "We announced our first project with Oracle and delivered power to their Utah site in less than two months," Bloom CEO KR Sridhar said on a post-earnings call on Thursday. "We are achieving the same thing with Nebius in New Jersey. We were able to get planning board approvals for our fuel cells within three months of signing the contract." Rystad predicts that about 40 per cent of projected US data-center capacity in 2030 could pursue dedicated on-site power rather than rely entirely on the grid. Fuel cells also produce lower local emissions than conventional gas-fired generation, as they avoid combustion within the stack. WHICH COMPANIES STAND TO BENEFIT? Bloom's third-quarter revenue surged 138 per cent to $1.24 billion. The company posted net profit of $250.3 million, compared to a year-earlier loss of $23.1 million. It raised its 2026 revenue forecast to $4.4 billion to $4.6 billion. US cloud computing giant Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom fuel-cell systems, of which 1.2 GW has been contracted. FuelCell is also targeting data centers. CEO Jason Few told Reuters that "time to power has really become as important as cost of power." The company expects data centers and related business to account for 75 per cent-85 per cent of its business within two to three years, up from 25 per cent-30 per cent currently. Rystad estimates the industry's order book at roughly 9 GW, including framework agreements involving Oracle, AEP, Equinix and Brookfield. Such agreements do not necessarily represent firm orders for the full stated capacity. CAN THE INDUSTRY SCALE FAST ENOUGH? Rystad expects annual fuel-cell manufacturing capacity to rise to 4 GW by 2030 from about 1.8 GW currently. "For 100 MW-plus projects, the biggest determinants of timeline are typically site readiness, permitting, and supporting infrastructure, not the fuel-cell technology itself," Bloom Chief Commercial Officer Aman Joshi told Reuters. Projects still need gas connections, permits, transformers and switchgear, which can delay deployment. Fuel cells can complement grid power, even as they compete with other on-site generation technologies. Growth depends on whether suppliers can deliver systems at competitive costs and developers can build projects and secure fuel.

Source: Reuters

item.title: パリ近郊で銃乱射、1人死亡4人負傷 デモ控え厳戒態勢の中
item.description: [パリ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２３日 ロイター] - フランス当局によると、パリ西郊のトラップで２３日、男が車から発砲し、１人が死亡、１２歳の少女を含む４人が負傷した。

マクロン大統領はＸへの投稿で、「既に容疑者を拘束した法執行機関に感謝したい。国家反テロ検察庁が本件を引き継いだ」と表明し、事件に深い悲しみを示した。

トラップのアリ・ラベ町長はＢＦＭＴＶに対し、男が車から発砲し、「無差別に発砲しているように見え、大量殺害を実行しようとしていた様子だった」と述べた。

トラップに隣接するラベリエールのニコラ・ダンビル町長は、容疑者について「近隣市プレジール在住の欧州系の人物」と説明した。ラベ町長は、犠牲者のうち２人がそれぞれアフリカ系と北アフリカ系だったと述べたが、他の犠牲者の背景についての詳細は明らかにしなかった。

今回の銃撃は、２４─２５日の抗議デモを控え、フランス国内の緊張が高まる中で起きた。１７日には全国規模の抗議デモが暴徒化した経緯がある。

当局は、今回の銃撃が人種や宗教を動機とするものだったのかについても捜査の対象に含めるとした。

item.title: 米ＳＥＣ、金融機関検査でＡＩや非公開資産を重点項目に
item.description: [ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - 米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）は２３日、２０２７会計年度（２６年１０月─２７年９月）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＳＥＣ、金融機関検査でＡＩや非公開資産を重点項目に 10/23 23:05 配信

2025年12月2日、SECのポール・アトキンス委員長　 REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - 米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）は２３日、２０２７会計年度（２６年１０月─２７年９月）の金融機関に対する検査で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の利用や非公開資産、トークン化証券などを重点項目とすると発表した。

トランプ政権は、老後資金を積み立てる人や個人投資家が非公開資産に投資する機会の拡大を進めている。こうした動きは高いリターンをもたらす可能性がある一方で、一般の米国民をより大きなリスクにさらすことにもなる。

ＳＥＣは９月、企業がブロックチェーンを活用したトークン化株式などを提供できるようにするため、５年間の規制適用免除措置を発表した。

ＳＥＣの検査部門は、投資顧問会社や証券会社、証券取引所など、ＳＥＣの監督下にある企業・機関を検査し、不正が見つかった場合は執行部門に付託できる。ＳＥＣは昨年、暗号資産（仮想通貨）分野に対する監視の重点度を引き下げた。

ＳＥＣは声明で、今年度の検査では、プライベートファンドやプライベートクレジットを重点項目に含めるとした。

批判的な立場からは、一般の投資家がこうした資産から期待通りの高いリターンを得られるとは限らず、資産の価格評価が難しいことが多く、すぐには現金化できない点や、手数料について理解していない可能性があるとの指摘が出ている。

声明によると、ＳＥＣは「市場運営や法令順守、不正防止、投資家保護に影響を及ぼし得る」ＡＩなどの技術の利用に加え、証券のトークン化を含む市場構造の変化に伴うリスクにも重点を置く方針だ。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 23:05 ロイター

Denmark is among the world's most digitalised countries, and confidence in its digital public ser

FAST

COPENHAGEN, Oct 23 : Denmark's heavy reliance on digital systems leaves it vulnerable to cyberattacks that could undermine public trust in authorities, the country's resilience minister told Reuters on Friday. Denmark is among the world's most digitalised countries, and confidence in its digital public services is high. Governments and companies worldwide, including in Denmark, this week took websites offline after critical flaws in a widely used programming language triggered millions of hacking attempts. Danish municipal IT company Kombit, for example, said it had shut down several services, including the national school communication platform. Resilience and Preparedness Minister Lisbeth Bech-Nielsen said Denmark's early embrace of digitalisation had delivered major benefits but also increased its exposure to cyber threats.

Utilities, healthcare and financial services all depend heavily on digital infrastructure. Her main concern is public confidence. Even attacks that cause limited disruption can weaken trust in authorities, she said, while the steady stream of reports about cyber incidents "has a very destructive impact on society". "The new normal is that we're going to be attacked on a daily basis, whether it's Russia, whether it's criminal hackers doing it for economic gain or something else," she said. The high level of trust Danes place in public institutions was evident during the COVID-19 pandemic, when strong vaccine uptake helped the country reopen society relatively quickly. Bech-Nielsen said Denmark needed to invest more in its digital infrastructure and reconsider how much critical equipment should be connected to the internet. She pointed to an incident in France in which freezers were remotely controlled, and questioned whether more local, closed systems would offer greater security. "We need to change some things fundamentally in how we arrange the digital infrastructure in Denmark, but it will affect a lot of people and a lot of ways of living, of doing business," she said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: イスラエル首相 、ヨルダン川西岸地区の住宅破壊表明 兵士2人の殺害受け
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２３日　ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は２３日、占領下のヨルダン川西岸のヘブロンを封鎖し、住宅を軒並み破壊すると表明した。イスラエル軍はこれに先立ち、同市近郊の軍検問所でパレスチナ人の襲撃者らが兵士２人を殺害したと発表していた。

イスラエル軍によると、襲撃者２人を殺害したほか、この襲撃で兵士３人が軽傷を負った。

ネタニヤフ氏は襲撃後の声明で、「われわれはこの場所を破壊し、完全に変えるために行動を起こす」と表明。さらに、イスラエル軍が定期的にパレスチナ人の都市や町を襲撃しているヨルダン川西岸で、大規模な軍事作戦を展開すると述べた。

ロイターの記者は、銃撃現場近くのヘブロンで、イスラエル軍のブルドーザーが住宅の取り壊しを始めたのを確認した。地元住民によると、これらの住宅は襲撃者らとは何の関係もないという。

ネタニヤフ氏は襲撃後の演説で、ヨルダン川西岸地区のイスラエル人入植者を「英雄的」だとし、彼らは「危険な最前線に立っている」と称えた。

今回の襲撃は、来週に控えたイスラエル総選挙を前に発生した。ネタニヤフ氏と同氏が率いる右派連立政権は、イスラエルの入植地の拡大とパレスチナ国家樹立反対を掲げて選挙運動を展開している。

item.title: ロシア・ウクライナ、南部オレシュキで停戦合意 米大統領夫人が仲介
item.description:
Steve Holland Ryan Patrick Jones
[ワシントン／キーウ／モスクワ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steve Holland　Ryan Patrick Jones

[ワシントン／キーウ／モスクワ　２３日　ロイター] - 米ホワイトハウスは２３日、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人が、ロシア占領下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシュキでの停戦合意をロシアとウクライナの間で取り付けたと発表した。停戦は２９日に開始する。ロシアとウクライナもオレシュキでの停戦合意を確認した。

オレシュキは２０２２年２月からロシア占領下にあり、食料支援が滞るなどして住民の人道危機が深刻化。ホワイトハウスの声明によると、ロシアとウクライナは人道支援物資の搬入と、指定された安全な回廊を通した民間人避難の準備を可能にするため、オレシュキでの全ての軍事行動を一時停止することで合意した。

メラニア氏は声明で「オレシュキの状況は極めて深刻だ。オレシュキは最前線の戦闘地域で、壊滅的な事態の瀬戸際にある。現地に残る住民の大半は高齢者で、医療支援や医薬品、食料、清潔な水を緊急に必要としている」とした。メラニア氏によると、停戦期間中はロシアとウクライナ両国の非軍事チームが住民宅を訪問し、ロシアまたはウクライナへの避難を希望する住民の移送を調整する。このプロセスを記録するために米国の報道機関が同行するとしたが、具体的にどの報道機関が同行するかは明らかにしなかった。

＜ロシア、ウクライナ停戦合意確認＞

ウクライナのアラハミヤ首席交渉官は、オレシュキでの停戦が近く実施されると確認。通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で、オレシュキと周辺地域からの避難と食料配送のために恒久的な人道回廊を設置する作戦を近く開始すると表明した。ただ、作戦の詳細は明らかにしなかった。

ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官も、米国の仲介でオレシュキを巡る局地的な停戦合意が成立したと確認。オレシュキからの退避を希望する全ての民間人に退避を認めるとし、避難には少なくとも数日かかるとの見通しを示した。オレシュキでの停戦についてはこのほど実施されたプーチン大統領とトランプ米大統領の電話会談でも協議されていたと述べ、停戦実現にメラニア氏が果たした役割を称賛。「人道作戦の調整に多大な貢献を果たしたメラニア夫人の尽力を歓迎する」と語った。

ペスコフ氏の発表を受け、ロシア軍のゲラシモフ参謀総長はオレシュキでの人道作戦を円滑に実施するため、ロシア軍は現地時間２７日午前４時（日本時間同日午前１０時）に攻撃を停止すると発表した。

メラニア氏はこれまでも、戦時中にロシアに連れ去られたウクライナの子どもたちを家族のもとに帰還させる取り組みに積極的に関与。声明によると、メラニア氏は代理人とともに、局地的な停戦条件を取りまとめるためにロシアとウクライナ両国の指導部と直接協議を行った。

オレシュキはドニプロ川を挟んでヘルソン州の州都ヘルソン市の対岸に位置している。ホワイトハウスによると人口は高齢者を中心に約１７００─２０００人と、ロシアによる全面侵攻前の約２万４０００人から減少した。同州のカホフカ水力発電所のダムが攻撃によって破壊された後、 オレシュキの約９０％が浸水したとされている。

item.title: Meta to delay new commercial terms criticised by publishers, advertisers
item.description: Meta Platforms will delay the implementation of updated commercial terms, so it can address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers, the US tech company said on Friday, in a decision that could stave off potential regulatory action.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) will delay the implementation of updated commercial terms, so it can address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers, the US tech company said on Friday, in a decision that could stave off potential regulatory action. EU and UK antitrust authorities have received [USN:L6N46817D TEXT:"complaints"] about the new commercial terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims. "We are extending the effective date of our updated Commercial Terms and Self-Serve Ad Terms to 20 November to allow more time for us to explain to our partners and stakeholders what's changing and what's not," a Meta spokesperson said in an email. The new commercial terms had previously been set to take effect on October 30. Meta will explain how it uses web crawlers and make clear that content owners will still be able to use robots.txt — a plain text file that communicates instructions to web crawlers and AI bots — to signal preferences, the spokesperson said. The European Commission, which serves as the EU's antitrust watchdog, said it welcomed the delay, adding that it had sent requests for information to companies that have not yet published summaries about the data used to train their AI models. The European Publishers Council, however, which together with other groups wants regulators to suspend Meta's new commercial terms while they investigate the issue, reiterated its criticism. It pointed to what it said was a lack of clear contractual safeguards against unrelated exploitation of publishers' content. "Maintaining a business page or advertising a subscription should not confer general rights over a publisher’s website and archive," the council's Executive Director Angela Mills Wade said. "Uses beyond those necessary to provide the specific service requested should require separate, express authorisation from the relevant rightsholder," she added. Publishers worldwide are ramping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair-use arguments.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine agree to ceasefire in Ukrainian city hit by food crisis, brokered by Melania Trump
item.description: US first lady Melania Trump has secured a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky, which will begin next Thursday, the White House said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Steve Holland, Ryan Patrick Jones
item.content:encoded: US first lady Melania Trump has secured a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky, which will begin next Thursday, the White House said on Friday. The chief of staff of Russian forces, Valery Gerasimov, said on the Defence Ministry's Telegram channel that Russian troops would halt fire from 4 a.m. local time (0100 GMT) on Tuesday to allow for the humanitarian operation to start. Residents of the southern Ukrainian city, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, have reported a deepening food [USN:L8N45K1N1 TEXT:"crisis"]. "Both nations agreed to temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway," a White House statement said. Ukraine's top negotiator, David Arakhamia, said on Telegram that the humanitarian operation would start once a ceasefire was in place. He said the accord, the result of a long process involving Melania Trump and Pope Leo, would set up a humanitarian corridor for residents to leave and allow assistance into the town. In Moscow, the Kremlin welcomed the agreement. It praised Melania Trump's role in securing the agreement and said President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin had discussed details. The Kremlin said earlier this week that work was under way to ease the humanitarian situation in Oleshky after Putin told the pope he was ready to cooperate on the issue. The development comes as President Trump pressures Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy to reach an agreement with Putin to end the war, which began when Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. FIRST LADY HAS SOUGHT TO HELP UKRAINIAN CHILDREN Melania Trump has been active in trying to get Ukrainian children seized by Russia during the war returned to their families. "The situation in Oleshky is dire. Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster. Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food, and clean water," Melania Trump said in the statement. The ceasefire will allow non-military teams from both countries to visit residents in their homes and coordinate transportation for those wishing to evacuate to either Russia or Ukraine, with an unnamed American media organization accompanying the teams to document the process, the first lady said. Newsmax, a right-leaning news outlet, said in a report that its cameras would be granted "exclusive access to document the effort." Oleshky, located across the Dnipro River from the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, has a remaining population of 1,700 to 2,000 people — primarily elderly residents, along with about 50 children — down from roughly 24,000 before the war, the White House said. About 90% of the city was flooded following the 2023 destruction of the Kakhovka Dam, according to the White House. The statement said Melania Trump and her representative worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to define the terms of the localized ceasefire. "Residents who wish to evacuate will receive coordinated support and transportation to their preferred destination. I anticipate some will want to go to Russia, and some to Ukraine,” Melania Trump said.

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Safety company Navigate360 on Friday acknowledged hackers had broken into one of its systems and copied months' worth of data, seven months after a widely publicized breach exposed millions of crime tips.  In a statement, Navigate360 said names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers and other sensitive information had potentially been exposed. Here are some details: • In March, a hacker calling themselves "Internet Yiff Machine" said they had broken into tip intelligence platform P3 Global Intel, an arm of Navigate360, and stolen 93 gigabytes of data, including 8 million confidential tips.

Oct 23 : Pathos AI said on Friday it had entered into a collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI to develop artificial intelligence tools for drug development in Alzheimer's disease and other neurological disorders. Pathos AI also raised $237 million in a Series E funding round led by Bristol Myers that valued the New York-based company at about $3 billion, with participation from existing investors. Here are some other details: • Tempus will build a dataset from hundreds of thousands of patients with neurological disorders to help track outcomes and speed research into disease biology

item.title: Explainer-Why is Meta creating a new class of non-voting shares amid its AI growth?
item.description: Oct 22 : Meta Platforms said on Wednesday that it is creating a new class of non-voting shares to fund its AI ambitions, pursue acquisitions and reward employees without weakening CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control.The move follows a structure used by some other founder-led companies, most notably Google's parent

FAST

Oct 22 : Meta Platforms said on Wednesday that it is creating a new class of non-voting shares to fund its AI ambitions, pursue acquisitions and reward employees without weakening CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control. The move follows a structure used by some other founder-led companies, most notably Google's parent Alphabet. WHAT IS META DOING? Meta plans to create a new class of publicly traded non-voting stock, known as Class C shares, and distribute one Class C share for each existing Class A and Class B share — effectively splitting its stock two-for-one. The new shares are expected to begin trading in January 2027.

The company said in a filing that the Class C stock will be available for raising capital, compensating employees, acquisitions and other corporate purposes. Meta expects to offer new shares from time to time. WHY NOW? The investment required to compete in artificial intelligence is "unprecedented," Meta said. It has forecast 2026 capital expenditures of $135 billion to $145 billion, as it races to build data centers, buy chips and expand computing infrastructure for AI. Debt financing on that scale can adversely affect credit ratings, making equity financing more attractive, the company noted. The management wants the Class C stock available as early as the end of 2026, Meta said in its filing. HOW DOES THIS HELP ZUCKERBERG? The structure allows Meta to raise equity capital without issuing additional voting stock. Zuckerberg controls the company through his super-voting Class B shares. By issuing non-voting Class C stock, Meta can sell shares to investors, use them for acquisitions or employees compensation, without significantly reducing his voting power. Preserving Zuckerberg's leadership was a key objective of the recapitalization, Meta's special committee said, adding that he would not support a significant equity financing that reduced his voting control. The committee proposed sunset provisions on the dual-class structure, which would have converted his Class B shares into Class A on triggers such as his death or disability, his leaving the company or a major reduction in his equity. Zuckerberg, however, indicated he would not support sunset provisions or any move that would lead to losing voting control. "Meta has massive capital needs to fund its AI expansion," said Dennis Dick, chief market strategist at Stock Trader Network. "We've seen companies issue more debt to finance AI expansion and investors have punished those stocks for impairing their balance sheets," he added, pointing to the stock prices of Oracle and CoreWeave. "This is a better way to raise capital while keeping the balance sheet strong." HOW MANY SHARES WILL ZUCKERBERG RECEIVE? Like all existing shareholders, he will get one Class C share for each Class A and Class B share he owns. As of October 1, 2026, he beneficially owned about 341.2 million Class B shares and 1.2 million Class A shares — representing about 60.6 per cent of Meta's voting power and an ownership position of 13.4 per cent. So, he will receive about 342.4 million Class C shares. Only 20 per cent of the Class C shares received by the "Holder Group" — Zuckerberg and some of those to whom he is permitted to transfer his shares to — will be freely saleable immediately, according to a separate Founder Alignment Agreement. The remainder will be subject to restrictions designed to prevent him from monetizing his stake without a corresponding reduction in voting influence. WHO HAS DONE THIS BEFORE? Google is the closest precedent. It announced plans for a non-voting Class C stock dividend in April 2012, and a shareholder class action followed in Delaware. Google settled, and the court approved the deal in October 2013. Under the settlement, Google agreed to compensate Class C holders if the shares traded at a discount of more than 1 per cent to Class A over the first year. The Class C stock dividend was distributed on April 2, 2014, and in 2015, Google determined it owed Class C holders a $522 million adjustment payment based on the percentage discount between Class A and Class C share prices. WHY DOES ZUCKERBERG WANT THEM? One motivation discussed in the filing is California's Proposition 40, a proposed wealth tax on the November 2026 ballot. It would impose a one-time tax equal to 5 per cent of net worth on billionaires who were California residents on January 1, 2026. It taxes accumulated wealth rather than income. Meta said Zuckerberg told the special committee he was evaluating whether to relocate because of the potential multibillion-dollar tax liability. The Class C structure would allow him to sell some non-voting shares without immediately reducing his voting control. Meta's board said Zuckerberg's existing ownership stake sufficiently aligns his interests with shareholders and therefore does not warrant additional cash compensation or equity awards, a position it said it has maintained for years.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Philippines investigates Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, after child sexual abuse images claims
item.description: Authorities in the Philippines are investigating Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, the wife of Britain's Prince Harry, the Philippine justice undersecretary said on Friday, after allegations he possessed child sexual abuse images.
item.dc:creator: Nestor Corrales
item.content:encoded: Authorities in the Philippines are investigating Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, the wife of Britain's Prince Harry, the Philippine justice undersecretary said on Friday, after allegations he possessed child sexual abuse images. "Our Anti-Trafficking and Anti-OSAEC (online sexual abuse and exploitation of children) task force in Cebu is currently investigating the matter," Nicholas Ty, Philippine justice undersecretary, told Reuters. Reuters could not immediately reach Thomas Markle for comment but he was quoted by the Daily Mail newspaper in Britain as saying the allegations against him were untrue and "sick lies". Meghan, who is American, married King Charles' younger son in 2018. In a statement, she said she was "deeply distressed" over the allegations, first published in Britain's Sun newspaper on Friday. MARKLE'S SON HANDED EVIDENCE TO POLICE Meghan said in her statement that she had known about the allegations against her father, 82, since 2018 and had prevented him from having contact with her children Archie, 7, and Lilibet, 5, to protect them. She has been out of contact with her father since the run-up to her 2018 wedding. Days before the event, Thomas Markle said he would not attend due to ill health after he earlier admitted posing for paparazzi pictures. Philippine interior minister Jonvic Remulla told Reuters it was Markle's son, Meghan's half-brother, who is also called Thomas, who provided police with evidence of the allegations, including a laptop, confirming details in the Sun newspaper. Meghan's father, who had lived in Cebu in the Philippines for some time, was now believed to be back in the United States, Remulla added. Meghan said she was shown a letter which had been sent to British police in 2018 with "troubling and disturbing" allegations about her father, adding that she was told they were being investigated. British police said they were aware of "media reports that officers from the Met's Royalty and Specialist Protection Command were involved in the passing on of a letter in 2018." "We are undertaking enquiries internally in an effort to confirm this," a spokesperson for the Metropolitan Police said. Meghan said she was "deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed. "My sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children," she said. The Sun also said Thomas Markle's son had contacted the FBI in the United States over the allegations. "The FBI is aware of the allegations and will provide support, as appropriate, to the Philippine authorities," the FBI said in a statement. "We will also investigate any related allegations of federal violations of U.S. law." [USN:L1N4610G2 TEXT:"Harry and Meghan"] and their children relocated to England in August after living in California for six years.

item.title: Soccer club Valencia says group backed by KKR founders buys 42% stake
item.description: Spanish soccer club Valencia CF said on Friday an investment group backed by KKR co-founders George Roberts and Henry Kravis would buy a 42% stake in the club in a deal valuing it at €1.25 billion ($1.4 billion) including debt.
item.dc:creator: Yantoultra Ngui
item.content:encoded: Spanish soccer club Valencia CF said on Friday an investment group backed by KKR co-founders George Roberts and Henry Kravis would buy a 42% stake in the club in a deal valuing it at €1.25 billion ($1.4 billion) including debt. Pitchwise Holdings, a consortium of family offices and long-term institutional investors led by sports executives Ann Rodriguez and Corey Woolfolk, will acquire the shares from majority owner Meriton Holdings, Valencia said. The investors will also inject €100 million into the club, Valencia said, adding that the deal remains subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals. Meriton will retain a majority stake, while Kiat Lim will remain president. Rodriguez and Woolfolk will join Lim in a new ownership group, Valencia said. The deal comes as wealthy families and institutional investors [USN:L4N43E020 TEXT:"increasingly seek exposure"] to sports franchises, attracted by their global audiences, media rights and commercial growth potential. Pitchwise's backers include Roberts and Kravis, co-founders and co-executive chairmen of KKR, the global investment firm, as well as Penner Sports Group, the Denver-based sports and entertainment holding company founded by Greg and Carrie Penner. Penner Sports Group's holdings include the NFL's Denver Broncos and a minority stake in Major League Baseball's Colorado Rockies, Valencia said. Lim said Pitchwise was selected from several interested parties because of its "long-term investment expertise and sports acumen". Valencia said the valuation reflects its men's and women's teams, the 49,000-seat Mestalla stadium and [USN:L4N3SS0RP TEXT:"the Nou Mestalla project"], which is expected to have capacity for more than 70,000 fans. The new ownership group will oversee the club's move to the Nou Mestalla stadium, which Valencia described as its most significant milestone in 100 years. ($1 = 0.8937 euros)

item.title: Seven killed as gunmen open fire at church in Jordan in 'terrorist' attack, authorities say
item.description: Seven people were killed on Friday when gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan, said the head of the country's Public Security Directorate, in a rare attack on Jordan's Christian minority that authorities described as a terrorist act by extremists.
item.dc:creator: Alaa al-Sukhni
item.content:encoded: Seven people were killed on Friday when gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan, said the head of the country's Public Security Directorate, in a rare attack on Jordan's Christian minority that authorities described as a terrorist act by extremists. Speaking at a press conference, Major General Abdallah al-Maaytah said most of those wounded in the shooting at the Hamoud Church in Karak governorate were still receiving treatment, and that the hunt for the attackers was ongoing. Jordan's health minister said 40 people were wounded. Interior Minister Mazin Al Farrayeh said the attack had been carried out by "extremists", but that it was too early to tell whether they had any links to known groups inside or outside Jordan. Such attacks are extremely rare in Jordan, which is relatively stable, though authorities in the US ally say that in recent years they have repeatedly foiled attempted attacks by Islamist militants. There was no immediate claim of responsibility. A video aired on Jordan's state-owned Al-Mamlaka television station that appeared to be from a security camera on the church showed three people firing at it from a sidewalk and hiding behind trees and a low wall. The video showed the attackers then running towards the church's entrance. Reuters was able to verify the video from the entry path and wall surrounding the church, as well as other details. "This is a result of a terrorist ideology and blind extremism and we will not allow society to go down this path," Jordanian Prime Minister Jafar Hassan said in a post on X. Khaled Burqan, who was at the funeral, told Al-Mamlaka that dozens of people were present and the gunmen opened fire on them for several minutes. Ihab Ammareen, another witness, told the station he saw bloodied people collapse on the floor after the attack. "People were crying, wailing, screaming — it's hard to describe," he said. BLOOD SMEARED ON THE GROUND Jordan's King Abdullah, a major US partner in the fight against militant Islamist groups, visited Karak hours after the attack and said the perpetrators would be punished "with an iron fist". "The terrorist attack against Karak will be met with the harshest retaliation. Those who delude themselves into thinking that they can divide Jordanians with their bullets have no chance in the face of our unity," he said in a statement. Reuters footage from the church after the attack showed blood smeared on the floor near its entrance, where security forces were deployed. In a post on X, United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned the violence and said attacks against civilians and places of worship are unacceptable. People who gathered at a Karak government hospital to support the wounded expressed shock. "What happened today has left people unable to speak or raise our voices. But our only reproach to the state is that it must investigate these dark ideas — where they come from and how they enter the minds of our children," said one of them, Hani Al-Mbaydeen. Christians make up a minority of Jordan's population. The country is home to several biblical sites that attract Christian pilgrims from around the world. The US ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz described it on X as a "depraved and brutal attack on a house of worship." Jordan was among the US allies in the region to be hit by Iranian attacks this year after the US and Israel launched strikes against Iran in February.

item.title: France Le Pnat saisi après des tirs dans les Yvelines, sur place Macron dénonce un acte terroriste raciste
item.description: Le président Emmanuel Macron s'est rendu à Trappes, dans les Yvelines, l'une des communes où un homme à bord d'un véhicule a tiré vendredi à l'arme automatique sur la voie publique, faisant un mort et quatre blessés graves, dont une fille de 12 ans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président Emmanuel Macron s'est rendu à Trappes, dans les Yvelines, l'une des communes où un homme à bord d'un véhicule a tiré vendredi à l'arme automatique sur la voie publique, faisant un mort et quatre blessés graves, dont une fille de 12 ans. Le chef de l'Etat français a déclaré que ces attaques étaient un acte terroriste raciste, notant que les victimes ont été visées "à raison de leur couleur (de peau) ou de la religion supposée et rien d'autre". "Ce qui s'est passé aujourd'hui, je le dis, c'est un tournant, parce que c'est la première fois qu'il y a un acte terroriste planifié pour tuer nos compatriotes, nos enfants", a insisté Emmanuel Macron, appelant à l'unité et invitant à "ne pas tomber dans le piège d'un camp contre l'autre". Le Parquet national antiterroriste (Pnat) avait [USN:S8N4390DW TEXT:"annoncé"] avant cette déclaration du chef de l'Etat l'ouverture d'une enquête pour assassinat en relation avec une entreprise terroriste après des attaques à Trappes et à la Verrière, deux communes à l'ouest de Paris. L'assaillant présumé de Trappes et La Verrière a été interpellé, a déclaré le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, qui s'est également rendu sur place, peu de temps après les faits. Laurent Nuñez a estimé que c'était "clairement" un acte terroriste, tandis que le maire de Trappes Ali Rabeh, à la tête d'une coalition municipale de gauche, a laissé entrevoir la piste d'un crime raciste. "Ce a quoi on a assisté aujourd'hui, c'est objectivement un attentat a connotation raciste, probablement islamophobe,", a-t-il déclaré à la presse. "Le tireur manifestement tirait au hasard et avait envie de faire un carnage", a-t-il ajouté sur BFM TV, évoquant des "tirs nourris" dans plusieurs quartiers de la ville, visant notamment un espace de jeux et une maison de santé ainsi que plusieurs véhicules. "C'est un miracle qu'on n'ait pas davantage de victimes", a-t-il ajouté. Dans un communiqué, le Pnat ajoute que son enquête est également ouverte du chef de "tentatives d'assassinats en relation avec une entreprise terroriste, avec la circonstance que les faits ont été commis à raison de l’appartenance vraie ou supposée, à une prétendue race, une ethnie, une nation ou une religion déterminée". Le Pnat retient afin les chef de "détention d'arme de catégorie A en relation avec entreprise terroriste" et d'"association de malfaiteurs terroriste en vue de la préparation de crimes contre les personnes". De son côté, Aurore Bergé, ministre déléguée à la lutte contre les discriminations, a dit espérer que "toute la nation" fera corps avec les habitants de Trappes et de La Verrière "si une motivation à caractère raciste de l'acte devait être retenue". Dans un communiqué, l'Association de Défense contre les Discriminations et les Actes Antimusulmans (ADDAM) a appelé à un accompagnement effectif des victimes, notamment un soutien psychologique, ainsi qu'une vigilance accrue autour des lieux de culte. "Les pouvoirs publics doivent continuer à prendre pleinement en considération le terrorisme d’ultradroite, la haine antimusulmane et les discours susceptibles de favoriser les passages à l'acte, dans l'espace public comme en ligne", écrit l'association.

item.title: British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says
item.description: Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says

Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.

PARIS: British and French jets flew together over the Mediterranean in their first joint exercise involving France's airborne nuclear capability, Paris said on Friday (Oct 23), underscoring their cooperation at a time of friction with Russia. The two allies agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.   "Having independent nuclear forces does not preclude coordination," said French Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin. "Our nuclear cooperation with the United Kingdom continues to deepen: on Tuesday evening, British Typhoons took part for the very first time in a French nuclear exercise alongside Rafales (warplanes)."

After taking off from the Saint-Dizier air base in northeastern France, the French jets were escorted by British RAF Typhoon fighters, simulating a nuclear strike in an exercise called "Rummy", France's Armed Forces ministry said. "In an increasingly dangerous world, our adversaries should be in no doubt: the United Kingdom and France stand together in their commitment to European security and to maintaining the deterrence that has helped preserve peace for generations," added British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting. France's President Emmanuel Macron said in March that Paris would expand its nuclear arsenal and launched an initiative offering European partners joint exercises and possible short-term deployment of French nuclear-capable assets on their territory.  France spends roughly €5.6 billion (US$6.04 billion) a year to maintain its stockpile of 290 submarine- and air-launched weapons — the world's fourth-largest arsenal.  Britain has 225 nuclear warheads.  In comparison, Russia and the United States have more than 5,000 each.

Source: Reuters/aj
